paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The provided line chart, titled "Llama3-8B on Basketball," illustrates the performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—of the Llama3-8B model as a function of "Question Popularity," which ranges from 5.0 to 25.0 in increments of 2.5. The vertical axis, labeled "Values," spans from 0.0 to 1.0, using a linear scale without specified units. The chart displays three distinct lines, each representing one metric and identified in the legend: Accuracy (blue line with circular markers), Confidence (green line with triangular markers), and Alignment (red line with square markers).

The Accuracy line (blue) begins at approximately 0.08 at Question Popularity 5.0 and exhibits a gradual, nearly flat increase, reaching approximately 0.28 at Question Popularity 25.0. The Confidence line (green) starts at approximately 0.57 at Question Popularity 5.0, rises to a local peak of approximately 0.61 near Question Popularity 7.5, then continues to increase steadily, reaching approximately 0.71 at Question Popularity 25.0. The Alignment line (red) begins at approximately 0.53 at Question Popularity 5.0, fluctuates slightly with minor dips and rises, and ends at approximately 0.56 at Question Popularity 25.0. All three lines are plotted with solid line styles and are evenly spaced along the horizontal axis.
